proof_body:
by
  intro f c w _ hc
  have h := MeasureTheory.Measure.integral_comp_mul_left (fun v : ℝ => Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * (w / c) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * f v) c
  have e : ∀ v : ℝ, Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * (c * v) * (w / c) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * f (c * v) = Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * f (c * v) := by
    intro v
    congr 3
    field_simp
  simp only [e] at h
  rw [h, abs_inv, Complex.real_smul]
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℂ) (c w : ℝ), MeasureTheory.Integrable f MeasureTheory.volume → c ≠ 0 → ∫ v : ℝ, Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * f (c * v) = ((|c|⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ∫ v : ℝ, Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * (w / c) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * f v
